subject: Transportation Systems
title: Evacuated Tube Transport History
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Evacuated Tube Transport History.

hook.text: Musk didn't invent vacuum tube transport. Engineers proposed it in 1799. Seriously.

buildup.text: George Medhurst patented a pneumatic tube system for passengers in early 1800s London.

discovery.text: In the 1960s, Rand Corporation and MIT studied vacuum tube trains extensively. Cost killed every study.

twist.text: Robert Goddard—the rocket pioneer—sketched a vacuum tube train design in 1910. It sat in a drawer.

climax.text: The idea resurfaces every generation. Each time, materials improve but the cost gap remains daunting.

punchline.text: Vacuum tube trains, reinvented every 50 years, still unrealized.

quiz.question: Who first patented a pneumatic passenger transport system?
